description: Changelog claims a breaking change in oldMethod(), but semantic-diff RAN at dts tier with 100% coverage and did NOT confirm it — a real disagreement, not 'we didn't look'. Per TRD §9.5 this is the changelogOnlyHighCoverage case → score 48 ('needs manual verification'). Bucket lands LOW (<60). Verification passes — but signal disagreement keeps it honest. This is the case where we MUST resist inflating to ship more PRs (§5b rule 6).

breakingChanges.description: Changelog says oldMethod() was removed in v6.
